name: Curved contours are liked more than sharp angles
claim: People liked pictures of curved objects more often than matched sharp-angled objects, about 67 percent against 51 percent (d = 0.94).
caveat: Fourteen people saw grey pictures for 84 ms; the threat link to sharp angles is the authors' proposal, not a measurement; later work found that the effect varies by object.

sources.title: Bar and Neta 2006, Humans prefer curved visual objects, Psychological Science 17(8)
